name_ja: ほんこさん／報恩講料理
name_en: Honkosan — the shojin meal served at Jodo Shinshu's autumn memorial gathering
summary_ja: 浄土真宗の年中最大行事「報恩講」に集まった人々へ、旬の野菜や豆を使った一汁三菜の精進料理をふるまう福井の食習。呉汁やおつぼなど地域ごとの一品が重なり合い、家庭の味として根づいたと伝わる。
summary_en: At Honkoko, Jodo Shinshu's biggest annual memorial gathering, participants are served a shojin meal of seasonal vegetables and beans built around one soup and three sides — dishes like gojiru and otsubo layered together into what is said to have become an everyday family taste.
source_title: ほんこさん／報恩講料理 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Houba meshi — rice and sweetened soybean flour pressed in a magnolia leaf
summary_ja: 炊きたてのごはんに砂糖入りきな粉をまぶし、ほお葉で挟んで重石をかける福井の田植え仕舞いの一品。葉の香りがご飯に移り持ち運びもしやすく、豊作祈願を込めた「さつきあげ」のごちそうと伝わる。
summary_en: Freshly steamed rice is dusted with sweetened soybean flour and pressed between two magnolia leaves — a dish marking the end of rice planting in Fukui. The leaf's scent seeps into the rice and makes it easy to carry, said to be the treat for the 'satsukiage' harvest-wish celebration.
source_title: ほうばめし 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Bokkake — a thick vegetable broth poured hot over freshly cooked rice
summary_ja: 厚揚げやごぼう、糸こんにゃくを削り節のだしで煮て、炊きたてのごはんに汁ごとぶっかける福井の一品。大正初期から100年以上食べ継がれ、勝山ではかまぼこや三つ葉を添えたお茶漬け風にもすると伝わる。
summary_en: Thick fried tofu, burdock, and shirataki noodles are simmered in a bonito broth and poured hot, broth and all, over freshly cooked rice — eaten for over a century since the early 1910s. In Katsuyama it is said to take a chazuke-like turn, topped with fish cake and mitsuba.
source_title: ぼっかけ 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Chameshi — rice cooked in barley tea with roasted soybeans
summary_ja: 炒った大豆を熱い豆入り番茶に浸し、その茶で米を炊き上げる今庄の一品。奈良の「奈良茶飯」が宿場町に伝わったとされ、仏事や報恩講の膳、里帰りする娘へのもてなしにも欠かせない味と伝わる。
summary_en: Roasted soybeans are steeped in hot roasted barley tea, and rice is then cooked in that same tea — a dish from the old post town of Imajo, said to descend from Nara's 'nara-chameshi'. It is said to be indispensable at memorial services, Honkoko, and for daughters visiting home.
source_title: 茶飯 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
